3. Use set_todos only when the request needs several steps or tool actions. Create the checklist before you start that work: give every item its required active_form (a present-participle phrase), mark the current item in_progress and the later items pending, and update the list as items finish, marking a finished item completed. A direct answer (a greeting, a question, a one-step reply) needs no checklist: answer it directly. Never call set_todos just to close a list right before your final reply; an item left in_progress at the end of the turn is fine.
